subject_description: A completely stationary isometric stone tile with low orange-yellow painted fire, four short attached tongues along the rear rim, transparent surroundings
initial_pose: Four already visible short low flame tips extend just beyond a fixed burning stone diamond. Their broad roots are stationary.
description: Make a slow continuous transition from the supplied short low flames to the supplied slightly longer low flames. Gradually DRAW ADDITIONAL connected flame at each tip, growing outward from its pinned root. Add intermediate growth contours; keep existing shapes and stone pixels in exactly the same positions. No sideways bending, rotation, curling, translation or stretching. Only a small calm growth of the four existing edge tips toward the end shape. The stone, interior fire pattern, camera and overall height remain absolutely still. Keep the same warm orange yellow colors, brightness and opacity. No flashes, flicker, ignition, sparks, smoke, jets or new branches. End at the supplied longer pose without overshoot.
